summary: A chaotic modelling synth whose oscillator is Chua's circuit, one per voice, feeding physical models, with an arpeggiator and a phrase generator that can play together and sync to external gear.
features: CHAOS runs from a pure cycle to the double scroll; 30 noise oscillators
17 physical models: resonators, strings and waveguides
Low pass gate per voice; reverbs, bodies, Leslie, delays and talk box
Arpeggiator and 46-effect phrase generator, combined with logic modes
MIDI clock in over USB or TRS, out over USB; chaos CCs
512 presets in four banks; manual is in Dutch
